findings: Public tag resolves to reviewed commit; source package version is a build placeholder0.0.1; npm repository points to continuum while documented public mirror is privatemode-public. Reproducible-build comparison not performed.
initializeWithManifestRetry fetches a replacement manifest on mismatch; supplied manifestBytes alone does not establish fail-closed pinning.
retryWithSecretRefresh retries once for no-secret-ID errors; OpenAI-layer retries also need explicit control. No retry behavior has been accepted for production.
GetAttestedMeshCA generates a32-byte nonce, validates Coordinator attestation and checks exact manifest equality. This does not establish continuous worker/GPU freshness.
Reviewed JS options and Wasm initialize do not expose strict OCSP/grace configuration; SDK equivalence to configurable proxy remains unresolved.
Go client generates a client-lifetime prompt-cache salt and injects it; no enforced worker cache expiry established.

apiBaseURL changes inference and attestation endpoint host; attestation constructs HTTPS host-root path, so a path-only local relay cannot simply be assumed compatible. Credential-safe relay remains untested.
